title: SimpleFactories
description: SimpleFactories is an automation mod that adds two machines that turn rare chance into infinite resource production.
body:
**SimpleFactories**

SimpleFactories adds two machines that turn rare chance into infinite resource production.
Crystallizer
Consumes items from the input slot and fuel from the fuel slot. Every processed item has a 1/1000 chance to produce one crystallized version. Crystallized items gain the "Crystallized" enchantment, purple glint, and tooltip text.
Extractor
Place one crystallized item in the seed slot and fuel in the fuel slot. The seed remains forever. Every few seconds the machine produces one normal copy of the seed item and drops it as an entity above the block.
How to use

Place a Crystallizer.
Put any stack of items in the input slot and fuel in the fuel slot.
Wait. Input depletes slowly. Very rarely a crystallized version appears in the output slot.
Move the crystallized item to the seed slot of an Extractor.
Add fuel to the Extractor.
Normal copies of the original item drop above the block indefinitely while fueled.

**Features**

Works with any vanilla or modded item
Accepts any furnace-compatible fuel
Crystallized items show purple glint and "Crystallized" tooltip
No dependencies
Lightweight and server-friendly

**Compatibility**

Forge / NeoForge 1.20.1 – 1.21.x
Tested in singleplayer and small servers.
